iris-local.sh.content_utf8:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export HOME=/home/irisowner IRISSYS=/home/irisowner/irissys
export ISC_PACKAGE_INSTANCENAME=IRIS ISC_PACKAGE_INSTALLDIR=/usr/irissys
export ISC_PACKAGE_IRISGROUP=irisowner ISC_PACKAGE_IRISUSER=irisowner ISC_PACKAGE_MGRGROUP=irisowner ISC_PACKAGE_MGRUSER=irisowner
export PATH=/home/irisowner/bin:$PATH
export TERM=dumb
iris list
iris start IRIS quietly
trap 'iris stop IRIS quietly >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
iris session IRIS -U USER <<'END_IRIS'
set status=$system.OBJ.Load("/work/Hello.cls","ck")
if $system.Status.IsError(status) { do $system.Status.DisplayError(status) halt }
do ##class(Corpus.Hello).Greet()
halt
END_IRIS

toolchain: InterSystems IRIS Community official OCI runtime
reproduction_command: sh iris-local.sh inside the digest-verified IRIS Community image
semantic_scope: The genuine IRIS compiler loaded the original class. A USER terminal session invoked Corpus.Hello.Greet and returned the exact greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
